propositions.wording: Our revolutionary AI transforms knowledge work.
propositions.critical_reason: The hype supplies no bounded demonstrated proposition and must not become an unsupported customer promise.
propositions.preserve: No determinate demonstrated capability is supplied by L1; omit the hype.

propositions.wording: Internal prototype test: summarized 20 supplied reports; accuracy and customer outcomes were not measured.
propositions.critical_reason: The prototype setting, action, count, and both measurement limits are essential.
propositions.preserve: Internal prototype test; summarized 20 supplied reports; accuracy unmeasured; customer outcomes unmeasured.

evidence_relationships.establishes: The hype has no bounded proposition suitable for factual verification in this writing task.
The prototype result and limits are supplied for editing, not independently verified.

reasoning_gaps: Accuracy, customer outcomes, production readiness, test date, and product version are not supplied.
answerability: A bounded prototype announcement is possible if all test and measurement limits remain beside the capability.
acceptable_outputs: In an internal prototype test, our AI summarized 20 supplied reports. Accuracy and customer outcomes were not measured.
Equivalent wording must keep the prototype and internal-test scope and both unmeasured outcomes.
forbidden_changes: Claiming accurate summaries, customer value, production readiness, automation of knowledge work, or measured productivity.
Removing either measurement limitation or presenting the 20 reports as a customer deployment.
questions_reason: This writing pilot assesses proposition preservation; reader-study questions are deferred.
